fixed.what_changed: The pull family gets the heading clause the rival family already has, and a report's own label for a part counts as a part reference beside 'part 2'. (a) New _PULL_HEADING, built character for character the way _RIVAL_HEADING is built: r"(?i)^[\s>*_`#\-]*(?:\d{1,2}[.)\]][ \t]*)?[\s*_`]*pulls?\b[\s*_`]*[:.–—\-]" — a line that opens with the word as a heading ('**Pull.**', '*Pull:*', '- **Pull.**', '3. Pull:') is the cross-step verdict whatever follows it. (b) New _PART_REF_LABEL = r"(?i)\bparts?\s+\d{1,2}\b|\bP\s?\d{1,2}\b", the reviewer's own regex. _pull_against is now `_PULL_HEADING.match(s) or (_PULL_AGAINST.search(s) and _PART_REF_LABEL.search(s))`.
